bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" ls "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1 | head; echo "===DATASET INFO==="; bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" show --format=prettyjson "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1 | grep -E '"location"|"id"' | head

cd "$(pwd)"

  "${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.user_embeddings" data/user_embeddings.csv \
  user_id:STRING,e1:FLOAT,e2:FLOAT,e3:FLOAT,e4:FLOAT,e5:FLOAT,e6:FLOAT,e7:FLOAT,e8:FLOAT 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "=== items ==="
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" load --replace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  "${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.item_embeddings" data/item_embeddings.csv \
  item_id:STRING,e1:FLOAT,e2:FLOAT,e3:FLOAT,e4:FLOAT,e5:FLOAT,e6:FLOAT,e7:FLOAT,e8:FLOAT 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "=== interactions ==="
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" load --replace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  "${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.interactions" data/interactions.csv \
  user_id:STRING,item_id:STRING 2>&1 | tail -3

cd "$(pwd)"
SQL="CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.recs75dfad\` AS
WITH scores AS (
  SELECT
    u.user_id,
    i.item_id,
    (u.e1*i.e1 + u.e2*i.e2 + u.e3*i.e3 + u.e4*i.e4 + u.e5*i.e5 + u.e6*i.e6 + u.e7*i.e7 + u.e8*i.e8) AS score
  FROM \`${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.user_embeddings\` u
  CROSS JOIN \`${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.item_embeddings\` i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM \`${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.interactions\` x
    WHERE x.user_id = u.user_id AND x.item_id = i.item_id
  )
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    user_id, item_id, score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY score DESC, item_id ASC) AS rank
  FROM scores
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(user_id, '#', CAST(rank AS STRING)) AS rec_id,
  user_id,
  rank,
  item_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 5
ORDER BY user_id, rank"
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false "$SQL" 2>&1 | tail -5
